data.description:
## Problem statement

The "Map" forced re-evaluation on WL-0MT3FLZJ20076X9B (comment 2026-08-24T21:26:17Z, "Audit re-evaluation (forced --force): Ready to close: Yes") produced a verdict and added it as a **work-item comment only** — it never called `wl audit-set` / `wl update --audit-text`. Consequences:

- The audit record (`audit_results` table) was NOT updated: `auditedAt` stayed at 2026-08-24T21:21:03Z while the item `updatedAt` moved to 21:26:17Z (the comment itself bumps `updatedAt` via `touchWorkItemUpdatedAt`).
- `isAuditFresh(auditedAt=21:21:03, updatedAt=21:26:17)` flipped to FALSE (60s buffer), so the TUI showed the stale-passed hourglass (⏳) and the herdr audit tier re-dispatched the item repeatedly — a self-perpetuating stale-audit loop (a fresh audit was re-recorded 2026-08-25T09:56Z).

RCA: the audit SKILL.md "Guidance for models" says re-audit only on explicit request (`--force` or clear directive) but does NOT mandate persistence for a forced re-evaluation; the closing-sentence convention ("Audit passed. The item is ready for release.") is output text, not a persistence call, and nothing stops an agent from posting the verdict as a comment instead of persisting it. Discovered-from: WL-0MT3FLZJ20076X9B.

## Desired change

Every audit verdict — including a forced re-evaluation (`--force`) — MUST be persisted via the canonical persister (`audit_runner.py` persists + readback-verifies; `persist_audit.py --issue-id <id>` is the standalone path) so `auditedAt` moves with the verdict. A re-evaluation that produces "Ready to close" must never leave the audit record behind while adding only a comment.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The audit skill documentation/guidance (SKILL.md "Guidance for models" + "Persistence Procedure") states explicitly that a forced re-evaluation is still a full audit run: it must persist via the runner/persister and verify with readback; a comment is optional extra, never the primary record
- [ ] `audit_runner.py issue <id> --force` persists (verified by `wl audit-show` readback) exactly like a non-forced run — regression test that `--force` output includes a fresh `auditedAt` and updates the `audit_results` row
- [ ] Make the runner emit a loud warning (stderr, non-zero? decide) when an agent-mode path would end with the verdict in a comment instead of the persisted record, so a missed persistence cannot silently mimic the observed loop
- [ ] Test: after a forced re-audit, `wl show <id> --json` audit.time == verdict time and `isAuditFresh` is true (audit is not shown as stale ⏳)
- [ ] Full project test suite passes (audit skill tests + runner tests)

## Key files (predicted)

- `/home/rgardler/.pi/agent/skills/audit/SKILL.md` — Guidance for models / Persistence Procedure wording
- `/home/rgardler/.pi/agent/skills/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py` — `--force` handling (~lines 4208–4266, 6500–6575, 7760–7835), persistence invariant
- `/home/rgardler/.pi/agent/skills/audit/scripts/persist_audit.py` — canonical persister (verify callers route through it)

## Related work

- WL-0MT3FLZJ20076X9B — observed comment-only re-evaluation (discovered-from)
- SA-0MSQ32MF200675AR — `--force` bypass child reuse (LP)
- audit SKILL.md — Persistence is mandatory, readback verification invariant
data.title: Audit re-evaluation must persist via wl audit-set, not only add a comment
